priorityList: Pre-combat: Cast Verdant Embrace to activate the Scarlet Adaptation buff.
Cast Dragonrage as your primary burst cooldown when available.
Use Tip the Scales during Dragonrage for an instant Eternity Surge or Fire Breath.
Sync Power Infusion, Potions, and offensive Trinkets with your Dragonrage window.
Cast Eternity Surge at Empower Level 1, but hold it if Dragonrage is available in less than 9 seconds.
Cast Fire Breath at Empower Level 1, but hold it if Dragonrage is available in less than 9 seconds.
Spend Essence and Essence Burst procs on Disintegrate; chain the next cast when the current one has 1 tick remaining.
Cast Living Flame whenever the Burnout proc is active.
Use Azure Sweep as a filler if the Tier Set bonus (Mid1_2pc) is active.
Use Living Flame as your primary filler, or while Leaping Flames or Ancient Flame buffs are active.
Use Azure Strike as a filler only when moving and Hover is unavailable.
Outside of Dragonrage, cast Emerald Blossom or Verdant Embrace to trigger Ancient Flame and Scarlet Adaptation for the haste and damage buffs.
Use Quell off-GCD to interrupt enemy spellcasting whenever possible.
